summary: Retest of iteration_15's 5 concrete PDF formatting bugs on Vedic Astrology + Numerology PDFs after fixes in /app/frontend/src/lib/pdfBuilders.js. Logged in as basic.test / premium.test, generated Ravi Kumar/1990-05-15/14:30/Mumbai on /basic and /premium, downloaded all 3 PDFs (basic.pdf 3pp, premium.pdf 6pp, premium_num.pdf 4pp) and rendered every affected page to PNG via pdftoppm at 130 DPI. Compared visuals + pdftotext -layout against iteration_15's failing screenshots. ALL 5 BUGS ARE VISUALLY FIXED. Regression checks — SNW watermark still renders as subtle circular mark just above 'Page X of N' footer on all content pages (verified basic p2/p3, premium p5, premium_num p4); Planetary Positions table retains Navamsha column + States column with Direct/Vargottam/Retrograde/Exalted/Retrograde, Vargottam values; Chandra Rashi + Navamsha D9 stacked snapshots render on basic p3; Vimshottari intro + current-running line preserved on premium p4; Numerology cover shows '6 · Venus / 3 · Jupiter / 7 · Ketu (South Node)' with 'Beauty / Wisdom / Mystic depth' trait sub-labels; cover 3x2 meta grid intact.
